name: TeamStarWolf - Refrigeration-Controller Attacks on European Supermarkets and Blood Services, 2026
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified record of the 2026 refrigeration-controller attacks on European supermarkets and blood services supports: the reconnaissance France's C4 describes (Modbus scanning, the FOFA service), the access classes the US joint fact sheet lists, Sekoia's honeypot telemetry, the default credentials at the Ransom-ISAC site and the supplier path to the French blood service. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/EUROPEAN_REFRIGERATION_ATTACKS_2026.md. The mappings are this study's reading.
